properties.areaDesc: Chaves, NM
properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued October 25 at 5:59PM MDT until October 25 at 6:15PM MDT by NWS Albuquerque NM
properties.description:
At 559 PM MDT, a severe thunderstorm was located 8 miles southwest of
Roswell, moving northeast at 15 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and quarter size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Hail damage to vehicles is expected. Expect wind damage to
roofs, siding, and trees.

Locations impacted include...
Roswell and Midway.

This includes Highway 285 between Mile Markers 100 and 104.
properties.instruction:
Seek shelter inside a well-built structure and stay away from
windows. This storm is capable of producing damaging winds and large
hail.

Continuous cloud to ground lightning is occurring with this storm.
Lightning is one of nature's leading killers. Remember, if you can
hear thunder, you are close enough to be struck by lightning.

NWSheadline: SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WARNING REMAINS IN EFFECT UNTIL 615 PM MDT FOR CENTRAL CHAVES COUNTY

properties.areaDesc: Curry, NM; Quay, NM
properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued October 25 at 5:51PM MDT until October 25 at 7:45PM MDT by NWS Albuquerque NM
properties.description:
At 551 PM MDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing heavy
rain across the warned area. Between 2 and 3.5 inches of rain have
fallen. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and as well as other poor drainage and
low-lying areas.

Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Forrest.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be aware of your surroundings and do not drive on flooded roads.

properties.areaDesc: Northern Copper Valley
properties.headline: Winter Weather Advisory issued October 25 at 3:49PM AKDT until October 25 at 10:00PM AKDT by NWS Anchorage AK
properties.description:
* WHAT...Snow expected. Total snow accumulations between 4 and 8
inches, highest amounts from Paxson north.

* WHERE...Northern Copper Valley.

* WHEN...Until 10 PM AKDT this evening.

* IMPACTS...Travel could be very difficult.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Snow will develop across the far northern
Copper River Valley beginning early this morning. The heaviest snow
is expected through 4 PM today before slowly tapering off. The best
chance for accumulating snow will be north of mile post 160 with
the highest snow amounts from Paxson north.
properties.instruction:
Slow down and use caution while traveling. For the latest road
conditions call 5 1 1 or visit 511.alaska.gov.

properties.areaDesc: Coastal Brunswick
properties.headline: Coastal Flood Advisory issued October 25 at 7:46PM EDT until October 26 at 10:00AM EDT by NWS Wilmington NC
properties.description:
* WHAT...Up to one foot of inundation above ground level in low-
lying areas near shorelines and tidal waterways.

* WHERE...Coastal Brunswick County.

* WHEN...Until 10 AM EDT Monday.

* IMPACTS...Low-lying roads and locations along the Intracoastal
Waterway and adjacent tidal creeks may observe minor coastal
flooding. Check with local officials for any road closures or
impacts.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Affected areas listed are based on
average tide conditions. Additional locations may experience
flooding during periods of heavy rainfall, high winds, or
other factors.
properties.instruction:
If travel is required, allow extra time as some roads may be
closed. Do not drive around barricades or through water of
unknown depth. Take the necessary actions to protect flood-prone
property.

NWSheadline: COASTAL FLOOD ADVISORY REMAINS IN EFFECT UNTIL 10 AM EDT MONDAY... ...BEACH HAZARDS STATEMENT WILL EXPIRE AT 8 PM EDT THIS EVENING

properties.areaDesc: Coastal Horry
properties.headline: Beach Hazards Statement issued October 25 at 7:46PM EDT until October 26 at 8:00PM EDT by NWS Wilmington NC
properties.description:
* WHAT...For the Coastal Flood Advisory, one to two feet of
inundation above ground level in low-lying areas near shorelines
and tidal waterways. For the Beach Hazards Statement, Strong
north to south longshore current. There is also a Moderate Risk
of rip currents expected.

* WHERE...Coastal Horry County.

* WHEN...For the Coastal Flood Advisory, until 10 AM EDT Monday.
For the Beach Hazards Statement, from 6 AM EDT Monday through
Monday evening.

* IMPACTS...Vulnerable causeways to and from local beaches will
experience minor coastal flooding. Low-lying roads and
locations along the Intracoastal Waterway and adjacent tidal
creeks will observe minor coastal flooding. Some roads may
become impassable. Check with local officials for the latest
information regarding coastal flood impacts and closures.
Longshore currents can sweep swimmers and surfers into rip
currents, piers, jetties, and other hazardous areas. It may
sweep swimmers off their feet, making it difficult to return
to shore.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Affected areas listed are based on
average tide conditions. Additional locations may experience
flooding during periods of heavy rainfall, high winds, or
